Adaptation: polygons simplified (0.035 degrees), coordinates rounded (0.001 degrees), spherical ring orientation normalized, split by time intervals. Dates and identities retained; alliance/composite RELATION rows excluded from the polity fill. These are approximate reconstructions, not surveyed annual borders.
